      title: Problem Detail

      type: object
      properties:
        type:

          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'

        title:
          title: Title

          example: NoResourceFoundException

          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600

          readOnly: true

          title: Detail

          readOnly: true
